subject: Ziggy reports Gemini4 access — verify model and fit existing bounded tests
body:
Ziggy directly said at06:35UTC: “Let the team know we have access to Gemini4 … we have to try some tests with it.”

Treat Gemini4 access as USER-REPORTED until exact displayed model, surface and account availability are verified. Do not infer new specifications, image/video capabilities, pricing or actual video engine from this report or a chat-model label. The screenshots remain with Ziggy; none are attached or newly shared by this notice.

At CFA Nova's NEXT SAFE CHECKPOINT, without interrupting active production, verify the exact visible model/version and application URL/surface, availability for this account, image/video/text modes actually exposed, and displayed allowances/cost constraints. Record dated evidence and unknowns separately. Inspect existing UI/configuration read-only; do not accept new legal/purchase prompts, buy anything or start a render from this notice.

Then fit a proposed bounded comparison into existing queued lettering, cinematic-motion or context tests, using exact source/output evidence and a single changed variable. Avoid duplicate jobs or a new parallel test series. Existing James conditional tests still wait for Grok's extra return and Ziggy's review; this notice does not release that gate or constitute a paid-render launch.

No generation, uploads, purchases, settings changes, new sharing or production acceptance is requested here. Posted is awareness queued only; it does not prove read, model access or testing.

Owner note: retain current authored work and use verified findings when updating existing provider-profile/shot guidance. Do not duplicate the global principles guide or dispatch a test from this awareness note.
